fact: On 22 April 2025 deputies began reviewing the national land cadastre bill, whose preamble says cadastral activities had been done in the Ministry of Public Works under a colonial-era provision and that the absence of a national cadastre has caused conflicts and weak property-tax collection.
title: Comienza el análisis del Proyecto de Ley sobre la Creación del Catastro Nacional de Tierras
publisher: Página Oficial del Gobierno de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
